scope: Host-owned shell details: dashboard icons, host resources accepted per content, host-initiated open that keeps a pending AI answer, light-theme contrast

assertions: missing or over-long host icons fall back to the kind icon
reactions and comments hidden where the host does not accept them
share and save stay where the host accepts them
every resource shows when the host says nothing
a host-initiated open keeps the AI answer the person was waiting for
light theme teal text and white-on-teal buttons meet 4.5:1

contrastMethod: WCAG 2.x relative luminance. Light --teal #067d75 → #05726b: text on --surface-2 4.27 → 4.94, on the 14% teal tint over glass 4.01 → 4.59, icons on the 25% tint ≥ 3.49 (non-text 3:1). --teal-dark #0d968c → #0a7a72: white text 3.65 → 5.20. Dark theme unchanged.

behaviour.userOpenDuringChat: answer not applied (unchanged — the person's own navigation supersedes)
behaviour.hostOpenDuringChat: answer applied, then the content opens

notChecked: referenceHostTests — the MetaHumotonic reference host is not on this machine; the program-feed adapter is unchanged
origin: Host handoff items from the MM host (U1 contrast, U4 host-initiated open, U5 per-content resources, U7 dashboard icons), made at the owner's request.
